serverInfo.description: NOTICE: Enrolling reservation members ahead of service — US stock price and price-trend delivery is paused. Korean stock prices are served in get_stock_prices and on company pages (latest values for attested personal paid subscribers, otherwise delayed by at least 20 minutes); Korean valuation multiples and price screens stay paused. US prices are not part of what FinBridge sells today; delivery is planned, not promised. Sign up free to be told if that changes: https://finbridge.gronox.kr/login . Filings, financial statements, segments, insider trades and 13F remain available. Korean company disclosures in English: DART filings, financial statements, segments, 13F. Korea (DART + KRX) first, from official sources only, with the US (SEC EDGAR), Japan (EDINET) and Europe (ESEF/IFRS) carried as comparison counterparts. Filings, financial statements, segment revenue, peer selection, insider trades and 13F holdings, with a watchlist and portfolio per account. Availability and redistribution conditions vary by source and dataset; responses include applicable source and coverage notices.
